name: [UPDATE] The Armory
desc:
Welcome to The Armory!
An intense extraction like PVP experience. Buy and clean guns in the armory, or venture out in "The Exclusion Zone" to capture, then clean as many guns as possible. Fight your way to the top


⚠️[EARLY ACCESS]
Why early access? Because we want to hear out the community, that way we will know what to prioritize next.

❓[How to play?]
- Buy, find and clean guns
- Use different solutions to alter the value of your guns
- PVP other players!
- Purchase hundreds of various cosmetics and armor
- Explore new POIs and safe zones, that each holds unique guns and items to scavange
